jobs.title: Business Analyst - Interfaces, Officer
jobs.description:
**Business Analyst, Officer, Interfaces**

  

**Job Description**

**What we are looking for**

We are seeking a **Business Analyst** responsible for bridging business, product, and technology teams to deliver innovative solutions across Charles River Investment Management System (IMS) and related front, middle, and back\-office workflows. This role plays a critical part in defining product capabilities, gathering and documenting requirements, validating functionality, and ensuring the successful delivery of solutions that meet client and business needs.


The Business Analyst will become a subject matter expert in Charles River products and investment workflows, partnering closely with clients, product managers, engineers, quality assurance, and implementation teams throughout the software development lifecycle. Working within a feature\-focused Agile team, they will leverage both financial industry expertise and technical knowledge to analyze complex business processes, define functional requirements, troubleshoot issues, and drive enhancements that improve the overall client experience.


This role requires a combination of strong analytical skills, financial market knowledge, technical aptitude, and the ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders. The successful candidate will be comfortable operating in a fast\-paced environment, managing multiple priorities, and independently driving initiatives from concept through delivery.


**Why this job is important to us**

Charles River Development brings together data and capabilities across the investment lifecycle to help our clients make better decisions, grow at scale, and deliver returns for their clients. Our diverse team of highly skilled technologists and professionals are agile thinkers and problem solvers, committed to our end users and engineering excellence. We use mentorship and teamwork to impact and drive our business forward every day.


By joining the Charles River Product Development team, you will work at the intersection of financial technology and investment management, helping shape products that power some of the world's largest asset managers, asset owners, and financial institutions. You will collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to deliver innovative solutions that streamline investment operations, improve data accuracy, and enable better investment decisions.


At Charles River Development (CRD), we've been creating some of the most insightful and sophisticated investment management technologies since 1997\. Through our commitment to product quality and client success, we've experienced continuous growth. Charles River IMS is strategically aligned to innovate the future of investment management technologies. Together with State Street's middle and back\-office capabilities, Charles River's cloud\-deployed software technology forms the foundation of State Street Alpha℠.


**What you are responsible for**

**Responsibilities:**

* Apply detailed knowledge of business requirements, investment workflows, and operational processes to support product development initiatives.
* Research, analyze, and produce comprehensive business and technical requirement documents.
* Analyze middle\-office and back\-office investment management workflows and create detailed functional specifications.
* Work directly with clients and product management teams to gather business requirements and develop product feature specifications.
* Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering through implementation and validation.
* Partner closely with engineering teams to design, develop, implement, and refine product capabilities.
* Plan and coordinate validation activities, perform hands\-on functional testing, and develop verification plans and processes.

* Review product documentation and ensure complete, accurate, and high\-quality deliverables.
* Support client beta programs and assist in training users on new product capabilities and releases.
* Assist in managing project schedules, milestones, deliverables, and dependencies.
* Collaborate with implementation and support teams to troubleshoot, reproduce, and resolve escalated client issues.
* Participate actively in the Agile software development process, including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Assist with Jira work item creation, refinement, prioritization, and tracking.
* Participate in integration testing activities and environment setup as required.
* Work closely with Quality Assurance teams to review and approve test plans, test cases, and validation results.
* Coordinate across engineering, QA, support, implementation, and product management teams to ensure successful and timely product releases.
* Identify risks, dependencies, and potential implementation challenges, proactively driving resolution to maintain project momentum.

**Requirements:**

* 10\+ years of experience working within the software development lifecycle, preferably in Agile environments.
* Strong experience analyzing investment management workflows, particularly middle\-office functions including position and tax lot reconciliation.
* Familiarity with financial instruments including equities, fixed income, foreign exchange, derivatives, and related asset classes.
* Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, including negotiation and stakeholder management.
* Advanced writing skills with the ability to abstract and summarize highly detailed technical and business information.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to reconcile conflicting requirements and data sources.

jobs.description:

**Project Role Description :** Own the technical direction and architecture of custom software solutions, leading teams through design and delivery. Set development standards and ensure code quality, scalability, and performance aligned to business objectives.
  

**Must have skills :** React Native  

**Good to have skills :** React.js  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

We are seeking an experienced software engineering professional to fulfill a technical engineering role. This position will contribute to and drive technical innovation, partner with cross\-team peers, influence and contribute to solution design and software delivery in a multi\-cloud environment.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

Develop and deliver high\-quality, customer\-facing user interface features within product teams using modern front\-end technologies  

Translate product requirements, UX designs, and technical specifications into performant, scalable, and maintainable UI components  

Build and maintain micro\-frontend\-based UI implementations aligned to product architecture  

Ensure all UI features adhere to accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG) and deliver consistent, usable experiences  

Implement well\-structured, testable, and efficient code using TypeScript  

Own UI quality by developing and maintaining unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests  

Integrate UI components with backend services via REST APIs  

Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Backend Engineers to refine requirements and provide feedback on feasibility, usability, and technical approach  

Participate in agile ceremonies and contribute to iterative, predictable product delivery  

Conduct and participate in code reviews, enforcing best practices and improving overall code quality  

Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve UI defects across development, testing, and production environments  

Contribute to build, deployment, and release processes through CI/CD pipelines using GitHub\-based workflows  

Identify and drive improvements in engineering practices, tooling, and team processes  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

  

Strong proficiency in TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and responsive UI development  

Advanced experience with React, including hooks and modern state management patterns  

Ability to translate design systems and UX artifacts into high\-quality, production\-ready UI implementations  

Strong understanding of UI fundamentals including layout, typography, visual hierarchy, and responsive design  

Experience implementing accessible UI components aligned to WCAG standards  

Proven ability to write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code  

Experience with unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing (e.g., Cypress)  

Strong commitment to code quality, testability, and automation  

Experience integrating with RESTful APIs  

Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, preferably using GitHub Actions  

Understanding of performance optimization and web application security best practices  

Experience working within agile product teams and participating in Scrum ceremonies  

Ability to review and provide feedback on product requirements, technical designs, and UX specifications  

Strong communication and collaboration skills across engineering, product, and design  

  

Educational Information:  

B.S. in Computer Science or Software Engineering, or equivalent education and experience  

Eight (8\) plus years of experience in application development  

Or equivalent combination of education and/or experience  

  

Additional Information:
  

  

You will be working with a Trusted Tax Technology Leader, committed to delivering reliable and innovative solutions

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

This position designs, develops, and manages activities for a specific product or group of products from product definition and planning through production, release, and end of life. Responsible for the full product lifecycle management, with a technical focus, including strategy, design, development, management, and end of life of new, existing or acquisition products. Leverage market insights to understand market/customer needs as well as emerging technology developments and trends to identify new opportunities or make adjustments to current product offerings. Balances deep subject matter expertise in the product, business use cases and solid technical aptitude. Accountable for delivering product performance against expectations and updates changes to a product portfolio to improve competitive position, and optimal product performance to meet customer and market needs. Accountable to and/or own the P\&L. Responsible for cross\-functional stakeholder management to include but not limited to design, engineering, scrum teams, business leaders, etc., functioning as technical expert with a fluency in development concepts and modern development practices. Positions in this function may require a background or degree in computer science or engineering.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Provides explanations and interpretations within area of expertise
* Functions as dedicated Technical Product Owner (TPO) on 2 right sized, preferably co\-located agile development teams. Responsible for backlog prioritization and refinement according to direction from Strategic Product Management (SPM) and other TPM leads
* Be able to articulate detailed product overview, benefits, and associated personas
* Follows existing and defined requirements gathering and PI execution process while considering and suggesting improvement opportunities
* Participates and presents PI plans for teams in PI planning events
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Graduate degree or equivalent experience
* 4\+ years of experience in product development or product management
* 2\+ years of product owner experience working on at least one agile scrum team
* Proficient understanding of the basics of the role of technical product management, agile practices/methodologies and the Software Development Life Cycle ((SDLC)
* Proficient level of experience in discovery, requirement definition and user story definition
* Proficient TPM assigned complex feature work on a single, primary product
* Proficient understanding of the role of technical product management, agile practices and the SDLC. Fluent with existing product tools for tracking and user story creation (Aha, Rally)
* Proficient level of experience in discovery, requirement definition and user story definition. With minimal guidance and oversight, can write quality stories, manage team and product dependencies and accept quality enhancements
* Proven excellent communication, organization and interpersonal skills

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Business, or a related field
* Certified scrum product owner
* Experience in product tools including Aha and Rally
* Experience with healthcare IT and/or knowledge of hospital revenue cycle

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

jobs.title: Senior Manager - RGM
jobs.description:
Overview:  

ICC is a growing function within PepsiCo that leverages one strategy and common approach to introduce new, technology\-driven capabilities and elevate service quality while meeting current and future business needs. PEP RGM is a key priority function where transformation, technology, strategy and capabilities enablement are aimed to be the best in class, and to be standardized and deployed globally. The vision is to develop playbook to develop analytic packs with insights across Brand Ladders, Channel PPA, In\-Market Pack Price realization, Trade Investment Strategy, Promo ROI and Mix Management. This work will accelerate growth through efficient positioning across price tiers, optimized channel\-based package types, right pricing, well directed commercial strategy and increase promotional ROI driven by enhanced and standardized insights.




This position will be part of the ICC \- Revenue growth Management organization. This position contributes to the success of the company and contribute to growth through strategy development, and implementation of RGM frameworks. The incumbement will work for different markets across the globe and work with different stakeholders to develop RGM playbooks and ensure analytics execution

  


Responsibilities:  

Functional Responsibilities

* ICC RGM analyst will be responsible for conducting data analyses across all RGM levers \- Pricing, Promotion, Assortment Mix and Trade Investment
* Lead data aggregation and harmonization that will form the backbone of RGM analytics
* Collaborate with Market Cluster Leads to understand market dynamics and incorporate market feedback into analyses
* Bring out Next Gen Revenue Management insights by implementing advance analytics
* Integrate insights comprehensive summaries for RGM Tower Lead and RGM leader
* Improve understanding of pricing, promotions, pack architecture and trade investments through use of data analytic tools and visualization tools
* Improve processes of analyses and data management across category business units and marketing functions
* Develop observations/insights for each analysis in the RGM playbook and synthesize insights across analyses to create a storyline of opportunities
* Implement continued improvements and simplifications of processes, standardization of reporting and optimal use of technology
* Create an inclusive and collaborative environment
* Adavanced Analytics – Price Elasticity, Promotion Effectiveness and knowledge of Python, R, Tableau/Power Bi


Key Activities


* Perform granular level analysis to identify growth opportunities
* Prepare data for the analyses to be performed (Data Pre\-processing Tools – Alteryx/KNIME exp preferred)
* Understand the nuances of the product category and market to tailor the output according to business needs
* Run the analyses and create visualizations (Power BI and Tableau experience preferred); prepare drill down analyses to derive insights
* Create a storyline out of various analyses output for the business to comprehend the output
* Meet the service level agreements and perform QC of the end\-to\-end analysis
* Expand playbook analytic pack scope to include additional analyses upon alignment with market

  


Qualifications:  

* \+7 years of experience in Retail Analytics/Category Management/Revenue Management
* 2\-3 years of relevant professional experience working with large data sets and experience in CPG /Consulting / ICC Organizations
* Experience in any of the RGM lever practices\- Pricing, Promo, Assortment, Trade Investment
* Strong analytics skills with expertise in data analytics and data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI
* Strong Advanced Analytics acumen, Agile ways of working, managing high end data science
* Prior experience in data analytics to derive data driven insights and consolidate them to generate recommendations
* Experience in developing data\-driven models for sales and marketing function
* Ability to handle multiple work streams simultaneously and to tight deadlines in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.
* Experience working with stakeholders in North America, LATAM, APAC, or EMEA markets (preferred)
* Very strong analytical skills – excellent competency in MS Excel is a must, as is experience of managing complex, incomplete \& inconsistent datasets and defining strategic analytics (market sizing/growth forecasts etc).
* Experience in Tableau / Power Bi is preferred
* Proven experience using PowerPoint and ability to producing visually compelling presentations (i.e. beyond just operating the software) that are impactful with a senior audience
* Clarity in communication (English language) to enable production of a very high standard of commentary that is impactful and credible amongst our most senior audiences.
* Bachelor’s in commerce/business administration/Engg., Master’s degree is a plus
* Best\-in\-class time management skills, ability to multitask, set priorities and plan

jobs.title: Product Manager, Google Pay
jobs.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* 3 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting).
* 3 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to senior leadership.
* 2 years of experience in software development or engineering.
* 2 years of experience working cross\-functionally with engineering, UX/UI, sales finance, and other stakeholders.
* 1 year of experience in technical leadership.

**About the job**
-----------------


At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  

  

In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  

  

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  


Google Pay is one the leading UPI apps in India. Our mission is to make payments and commerce simple, fast, and reliable to unlock a brighter financial future for all Indians. We aim to provide affordable access to financial services to every Indian. Specifically, Google Pay aims to empower every Indian with the confidence to participate in the digital economy by making it the simplest, safest, and most trusted financial platform. The overall goal is to reduce friction in transactions and increase the value of money experiences.


Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Work with partner teams (e.g., engineers, PgMs, UX) during product design and development to implement the requirements to turn PRDs into OKRs for one or more teams.
* Define product roadmaps by operationalizing strategy.
* Develop and secure buy\-in for a product goal that identifies, defines, and supports the overall product narrative and direction, achieving an outcome that is greater than the sum of its parts.
* Validate the market size and opportunity (e.g., user\-based, strategic opportunity, business generation).
* Drive launches, maintenance, and retirement in collaboration with other cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.

Providence has a network of 51 hospitals, 1,000\+ care clinics, senior services, supportive housing, and other health and educational services in the US.


Providence India is bringing to fruition the transformational shift of the healthcare ecosystem to Health 2\.0\. The India center will have focused efforts around healthcare technology and innovation, and play a vital role in driving digital transformation of health systems for improved patient outcomes and experiences, caregiver efficiency, and running the business of Providence at scale.

-----------

* Best In\-class Benefits
* Inclusive Leadership
* Reimagining Healthcare
* Competitive Pay

* Provide technical leadership in software design and architecture, ensuring adherence to best practices and scalability
* Stay updated with the latest advancements in Language Model frameworks and contribute to their integration and enhancement within our software ecosystem.

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including product managers, designers, and developers to deliver high\-quality software solutions.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

* Excellent communication skills and ability to manage stakeholders, ensuring alignment of technical solutions with business goals.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail in software design and architecture.
* Previous experience mentoring junior engineers and guiding technical decisions.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Associate Product Manager \- Live Services** 




  





**About Us** 




 Liquidnitro Games is a game development company built to create, launch, and scale ambitious games for a global audience.
 



 Founded by industry veterans with deep experience across free\-to\-play, live services, and large\-scale game production agnostic of platforms, we bring together product thinking, design craft, engineering depth, art execution, data, and live operations under one roof.
 



 We build games from the ground up, take new ideas from 0 to 1, and work with select partners to strengthen, scale, and operate high\-quality game experiences. Our teams combine creative ownership with production discipline, helping projects move from early prototypes to validated products, and from launch to long\-term growth.
 



 At Liquidnitro, we are building the next generation of game teams, products, and tools from India for the global games industry.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are looking for an
 **Associate Product Manager** 
 to join a team operating and growing a live game.
 



 This role sits at the intersection of players, product, data, design, and live operations. You will help understand how players engage with the game, identify opportunities to improve the experience, and work with cross\-functional teams to turn those insights into product changes, features, events, and experiments.
 



 You should be comfortable moving between data and gameplay, understanding both what the numbers are telling us and what is happening inside the game. The goal is not just to report performance, but to understand why players behave the way they do and what we should do next.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Analyse player behaviour across retention, engagement, progression, monetization, and live events.
* Build a strong understanding of the game's core loop, progression systems, economy, content, and player segments.
* Identify product opportunities and translate them into clear hypotheses and recommendations.
* Work closely with Product Management, Game Design, Analytics, Production, Engineering, and other cross functional teams to improve the game.
* Support the design and evaluation of features, events, offers, progression changes, and monetization initiatives.
* Define success metrics for product changes and evaluate performance after launch.
* Design and analyse A/B tests and other experiments.
* Use cohort and segmentation analysis to understand differences in player behaviour.
* Investigate changes in KPIs and identify the underlying causes rather than stopping at surface\-level reporting.
* Review the performance of live events and features and recommend changes based on player behaviour and outcomes.
* Track competitive games, market trends, and relevant product mechanics.
* Contribute to product roadmap and live\-ops planning based on player needs, game performance, and business priorities.
* Communicate insights and recommendations clearly to both product and development teams.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 1\-3 years of experience in product management – preferably in gaming or consumer related products.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work with data and convert analysis into actionable product decisions.
* Understanding of free\-to\-play game metrics such as retention, engagement, conversion, ARPDAU, and LTV.
* Strong interest in games and a good instinct for player experience.
* Ability to think in hypotheses, test assumptions, and measure outcomes.
* Comfortable working across multiple disciplines and communicating with both creative and technical teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* High attention to detail and curiosity about why systems and players behave the way they do.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience working on a live mobile or free\-to\-play game.
* Working knowledge of SQL and BI or analytics tools.
* Experience with A/B testing, cohort analysis, and player segmentation.
* Understanding of game economies, progression systems, rewards, and monetization.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 You are able to move beyond reporting that a metric changed and explain why it changed, which players were affected, what part of the game caused it, and what we should do next.
 



 Over time, you should develop enough understanding of the game and its players to independently identify product opportunities, build a case for them using data and player insight, and help drive them from hypothesis through implementation and measurement.

**Associate, Channel Operations – Contracts \& Pricing Execution (AIN)**

**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**


At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.


Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

**What you will do**


As the Associate, Channel Operations – Contracts \& Pricing Execution (AIN), you will support execution of U.S. Channel operations within the Contracts \& Pricing Execution function. This role will support contract update processing, CDP maintenance, GCPS processing, scorecard generation, payment validation, DOH analysis, reconciliation activities, reporting, controls, documentation, and operational improvement initiatives supporting Channel Payments and Channel Analytics processes.


The role will partner with Channel Managers, AIN team members, ATO Channel SMEs, National Account Managers, Finance, Commercial Operations, Pricing, Trade Operations, Analytics teams, Information Systems, and other U.S.\-based stakeholders to support accurate, timely, and compliant Channel execution. **Key Responsibilities**

*Channel Operations \& Execution*

* Support day\-to\-day execution of Channel operations including CDP updates, GCPS maintenance, payment package preparation, scorecard generation, tracker maintenance, reporting support, and documentation management.
* Execute assigned standard\-state Channel activities in accordance with SOPs, desktop procedures, validation checklists, quality standards, and established timelines.
* Maintain accurate trackers for contract updates, CDP changes, scorecard status, waiver activity, payment readiness, reconciliations, open items, and evidence retention.

* Support Conga review activities, contract amendment tracking, Monthly and Quarterly CDP Update preparation, and maintenance of supporting documentation.

* Assist with CDP\-to\-GCPS validation, peer review support, discrepancy documentation, and issue resolution tracking.
* Maintain supporting files including master files, strategy trackers, product updates, waiver trackers, and contract\-related documentation.

*Scorecards, Validation \& Payment Support*

* Generate and maintain scorecards using approved master files, DOH inputs, net sales data, and contractual parameters.
* Perform first\-pass validation of scorecards, payment calculations, performance reports, reconciliations, and supporting reporting outputs.
* Support payment package preparation, payment tracker updates, variance research, documentation preparation, and approval package readiness.
* Investigate standard discrepancies and coordinate supporting data collection for manager review.

*Analytics, Reconciliation \& Reporting*

* Support net sales reconciliation activities across SAP, GCPS, IntegriChain, and related reporting sources.
* Perform recurring DOH calculations, direct sales validation, 852/867 review support, variance analysis, and compliance reporting activities.
* Assist with trend reporting, scorecard reporting, performance reporting, payment package support, and routine operational dashboards.
* Maintain audit\-ready supporting workpapers and reconciliation documentation.

*Product Launch \& Master Data Support*

* Support routine product launch tracking activities, MMDS documentation updates, master data coordination, and approved pricing update activities.
* Assist with price list maintenance, documentation readiness, product setup tracking, and launch\-related reporting.
* Maintain launch documentation, approvals, and supporting records in accordance with SOP requirements.

*Compliance, Controls \& Audit Readiness*

* Execute work in accordance with Channel SOPs, SOX controls, documentation requirements, and compliance expectations.
* Maintain audit\-ready evidence supporting validations, reconciliations, payment activities, approvals, and operational controls.
* Support internal audits, SOX reviews, KT activities, documentation updates, and process compliance reviews.
* Escalate data integrity, compliance, operational, or financial risks promptly and support remediation efforts.

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. Our Values

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

Turn what works into repeatable factory practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio\-scale transformation.

**Hire and grow strong engineers**


Recruit, coach, and develop engineers who are comfortable working across legacy code and modern service design. Set clear expectations, give honest feedback, and build a culture of ownership, craft, and follow\-through.

**Partner across the program**


Work closely with product, program leadership, principal engineering, SRE, security, and data teams to sequence domains by customer impact and technical dependency, surface risk early, and keep cross\-team commitments visible and managed.

**What This Is Not**


This is not an architecture\-only or people\-only role. You are expected to engage credibly with design and delivery detail, challenge weak technical assumptions, and be accountable for outcomes — while your engineers own the code.


This is not a greenfield platform build. The value of this work is measured by safely converging live, revenue\-critical systems onto shared services, not by producing new frameworks. Decisions must balance long\-term platform quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications.


This is not a big\-bang rebuild or a customer migration program. The transformation is evolutionary: systems stay releasable throughout, and customers experience better capabilities, not disruptive migration events.

Experience decomposing monoliths, extracting services, and defining domain boundaries, ownership models, and migration strategies within complex existing environments — and delivering those migrations to production.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.**
 We are looking for a
 **Senior Technical Product Owner** 
 to drive the vision, roadmap, and delivery of key digital products, including FinOps and AI agent solutions. This role will own products end\-to\-end, ensuring they deliver measurable business value, drive adoption, and support WSA's digital transformation journey.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* FinOps. Our FinOps products give engineering teams and finance a shared, trustworthy view of cloud spend across our providers and push cost accountability into the teams that create the cost. You own their vision, roadmap and backlog end to end.
* Discovery for what comes next. New products are taking shape in our cloud and platform strategy area. You will help develop them through product discovery, prototypes and stakeholder interviews, and give them a definition and a first roadmap. Who owns them in the end is decided later.
* Possibly more. Depending on the profile we find, smaller existing products can be added to your responsibilities – our Backstage developer portal, or our Google Cloud and Alibaba Cloud offerings, for example.
* Outcomes, not output. You are measured on adoption across the applications on the platform and on the decisions that change because of your product, not on the number of stories closed. You present your roadmap and your results to leadership yourself.


 What you will do
   

  

* Talk to the people who use our FinOps products – platform teams, application teams and finance – and turn what you learn into a roadmap they recognise as theirs.
* Write the user stories and acceptance criteria yourself. You know the difference between a story and a specification.
* Prioritise against business value, technical feasibility and the platform strategy, and defend the ranking when it is challenged.
* Work with the engineering team day to day: refinement, design reviews, demos and releases. You can read the code and the architecture, and you will.
* Track adoption and outcomes, and act on what the numbers tell you.
* Manage expectations and dependencies with stakeholders across WSA.
* Run product discovery and stakeholder interviews for new products in the strategy area


**What You Bring**
* A technical background: 5\+ years in software engineering, architecture or platform engineering, and real responsibility for deciding what gets built – as a product owner, a tech lead or an architect.
* You have shipped something other teams depend on – an internal platform, a service, a tool – and lived with the consequences.
* You understand cloud platforms well enough to challenge an engineer's estimate and to spot when a cost report is wrong. Hands\-on FinOps experience is a plus; the practice can be learned, the instinct cannot.
* You have made a case to senior stakeholders, won some and lost some, and can explain what you would do differently.
* You can work with an empowered agile team without needing to run it. Scrum or SAFe familiarity is useful; process for its own sake is not.
* You are interested in LLM\- and agent\-based solutions and have a realistic view of what they can and cannot do today.
* Clear written and spoken English, and comfortable working in a multi\-region team across time zones..


**Who We Are**
 At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.
   

  

 Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.
   

  

 With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.
   

  

**Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.**
 WSA is an equal\-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.

**About Parexel**
 Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights\-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000\+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient\-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
   

  

 We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst to join our team. As a Senior Business Analyst, you will drive strategic improvements across clinical research operations by analyzing complex business processes, gathering and translating stakeholder requirements, and designing solutions that enhance efficiency and compliance. This position plays a key role in process optimization, system implementation, requirements management, and operational transformation. You'll collaborate with cross\-functional teams across clinical operations, follow industry\-standard methodologies, and contribute to strategic initiatives from planning through execution.
   

  

 Responsibilities include leading comprehensive business analysis activities, conducting process improvement initiatives, designing solutions that meet business requirements, and mentoring team members. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Business Analyst can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research operations and technology integration.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead comprehensive analysis of business needs, processes, and workflows across clinical research functions
* Conduct thorough requirements gathering sessions with stakeholders at all levels and translate complex business needs into clear, detailed, and actionable requirements documentation
* Develop use cases, user stories, and functional specifications that accurately reflect business requirements and validate requirements with stakeholders to ensure completeness and accuracy
* Analyze current state business processes to identify inefficiencies and gaps, document existing workflows using process mapping techniques, and design future state processes that optimize efficiency, quality, and compliance
* Develop recommendations for process standardization and automation, perform cost\-benefit analyses for proposed process changes, and measure and report on the effectiveness of implemented improvements
* Collaborate with technical teams to design solutions that meet business requirements and develop functional specifications and design documents for system implementations
* Support the development and execution of test plans and test cases, validate that implemented solutions meet business requirements and quality standards, and develop training materials and support documentation for end users
* Lead business analysis activities for medium to large\-scale projects, develop project scope and deliverables, create and manage business analysis work plans and timelines, and identify and manage risks related to requirements and solution implementation
* Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across clinical operations, facilitate communication between business units and technology teams, and present analysis findings and recommendations to stakeholders at various levels
* Mentor junior business analysts and share best practices, stay current with industry trends and regulatory changes affecting clinical research, and identify opportunities for innovation in clinical processes and systems


**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**
* Advanced analytical and problem\-solving skills with expertise in business process analysis, requirements management, and process improvement methodologies
* Proficiency with business analysis tools and software (JIRA, Confluence, Visio) and familiarity with process modeling notations (BPMN, UML, flowcharts)

jobs.description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real\-time cross\-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.



Co\-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11\-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.



It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.



Our payout network spans 190\+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 \+ corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40\+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross\-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross\-Border Payments Companies list.



In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1\.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high\-growth company.

 **About the Role**



Nium moves billions in payments every month for some of the world’s most demanding companies — banks, fintechs, and enterprise platforms operating across 100\+ countries. We built that on fiat rails. The next layer is digital currency: stablecoins, on/off\-ramps, and card products that let customers spend, settle, and move value in USDC as naturally as they do in dollars or euros.



We’re hiring a Staff PM – Digital Assets to own that build. Not the strategy document — the actual product. If you’ve shipped a stablecoin wallet, a crypto\-funded card, or a fiat\-to\-digital conversion flow and you understand what it takes to get that through compliance, engineering, and go\-live in a regulated environment, this is your rol



### **Responsibilities**


* Own stablecoin\-funded card products — physical and virtual cards funded from or settled in stablecoins (USDC and equivalents). Define the product, get it through compliance, ship it.
* Build digital asset support into Nium’s multi\-currency wallet — hold, convert, and send stablecoins alongside fiat currencies. This is a wallet extension, not a new product line.
* Design and ship on/off\-ramp flows — fiat\-to\-digital and digital\-to\-fiat conversion, including rate logic, settlement timing, and failure handling. Own the full customer experience.
* Drive stablecoin\-based cross\-border settlement — payin and payout flows that clear on digital rails. Work with network and settlement teams to make these production\-grade.
* Evaluate and integrate custodians, exchanges, and blockchain infrastructure — as infrastructure decisions with integration timelines and SLAs, not as partnership strategy.
* Own compliance product design for digital assets — MiCA, VASP frameworks, travel rule, FinCEN requirements. These get built into the product spec, not handed off to legal.
### **Requirements**

* 7\+ years in product management. Fintech, crypto infrastructure, or payments required.
* You’ve shipped at least one digital asset product in production — a stablecoin wallet, a crypto card, an on/off\-ramp, or a digital settlement rail. Not a prototype. Not a strategy deck.
* Strong payments foundation — cross\-border flows, FX, wallets, settlement mechanics. Digital assets are an extension of this, not a departure from it.
* Regulatory fluency as a product skill — you know what MiCA, travel rule, VASP registration, and FinCEN MSB requirements mean for your spec, your launch sequence, and your go/no\-go decisions.
* Experience working with custodians, blockchain infrastructure, or card networks — enough to evaluate integration tradeoffs and write requirements that engineering can build against.
* Comfortable operating in high\-ambiguity, high\-compliance environments — you know when to move and when to wait for legal sign\-off.
### **How We’ll Measure Success**


* Volume settled on digital rails (stablecoin payins \+ payouts) — tracked quarterly against target
* Card activation rate and spend volume for stablecoin\-funded card products
* On/off\-ramp conversion rate and time\-to\-settlement
* Time\-to\-integration for new custodian or blockchain network partners
* Regulatory coverage: number of markets with compliant, live digital asset product

**We Care for Our Employees:** The wellness of Nium’ers is our \#1 priority. You will manage direct\-to\-consumer (D2C) sales performance across the Pixel ecosystem (Pixel phones, Pixel Watch, Pixel Buds, Nest, and accessories), designing promotional strategies, optimizing affordability and conversion mechanics (financing, trade\-in/exchange, EMI), and collaborating with cross\-functional stakeholders across APAC and global teams.

We also create seamless discovery, trade\-in, financing, onboarding, and customer care experiences, and position the Google Store as the benchmark for how Google hardware, AI, and software work together.**Responsibilities**

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Greenlight is a family technology company on a mission to help families raise financially smart kids and navigate life together. Its suite of products — including the Greenlight app, debit card, Safe Family GPS trackers, and Family Hub — brings together financial tools, safety features, and everyday family management in one connected experience. Designed for busy families who want convenience without compromise, Greenlight continues to innovate alongside the evolving needs of modern life. Today, more than 6\.5 million family members trust Greenlight to stay in sync.
 



  





 At Greenlight, we're here to make the day\-to\-day easier and futures brighter, so families can spend less time managing life, and more time living it. That's why we get out of bed every morning.
 



  





 Common Platforms builds the foundations every other product team depends on. Access, identity management, authentication and notifications are the foundation every Greenlight experience runs on, they decide who gets into the door, and whether the right person hears from us at the right moment. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager, Common Platforms to own this layer end\-to\-end: the Identity and access management, the permissions that govern what parents and kids can each do, and the multi\-channel notification platform that reaches millions of families every day.
 



  





 This is a high\-leverage, high\-trust role at the center of Greenlight's platform organization. Your customers are both the families using our products who should never have to think about any of this and the product teams building on top of you, who ship faster when your systems are reliable. You'll work cross\-functionally across teams at Greenlight (US \& India) , and you'll have direct line\-of\-sight to executive leadership on the decisions that shape customer trust and platform reliability. The right person thinks in systems, and is comfortable building core platform products.
 



  





 This role reports to the Director of Product and sits within the Common Platforms team.
 



  





**Your day\-to\-day:** 



* Working closely with Engineering and design to ensure building great product.
* Work closely with key stakeholders for new requirements and ensure to keep teams updated on ongoing items
* Owning the key metrics for your product and ensuring the reliability of the product.
* Embedded in a dedicated cross\-functional pod with Engineering and Design, with close partnerships across Security, Risk and Compliance, Legal, Data, Customer Support, and the consumer product teams who depend on your platform.



  





**What you’ll bring to the team:** 



* 6\+ years in product management, with at least 2 years building platform products
* Comfortable to build long term strategy for your product vertical and drive the key projects independently end to end.
* Strong cross\-functional instincts \- you’ve navigated complex stakeholder environments including Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Payments, and know how to move fast within constraints.
* Executive presence: you communicate up and across clearly, adapt your message to your audience, and don’t wait to be asked for updates.
* Ownership mentality \- you proactively identify gaps, propose solutions, and follow through. You don’t need a playbook to get started.
* Urgency and scrappiness: experience in fast\-paced, high\-growth environments where speed matters and you figure things out yourself.



  





**Good to have:** 



* Fintech experience or a familiarity with identity and access management (IAM), authentication standards



  





**Who we are:** 




 It takes a talented team to aim for a mission like ours. We're looking for people who ask "is it bold enough?" People who bring their real selves to the table and push the people around them to do the same. We win by never hesitating to jump in, offer a hand, or share the credit, because we know we're stronger together than apart. And through all of it, the mission stays the thing we measure ourselves against: are we doing right by the families counting on us? If that sounds like your kind of team, we'd love for you to apply.
 



  





 Greenlight is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on age, race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition (including pregnancy, childbirth, or a medical condition related to pregnancy or childbirth), genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

* Design scalable, maintainable solutions aligned with platform best practices and organizational standards.
* Translate business requirements into technical designs, data models, workflows, and integrations.
* Lead technical design sessions, solution reviews, and architecture discussions with developers and stakeholders.

* Drive automation, workflow optimization, and platform performance improvements.

* Deep understanding of ServiceNow architecture, data models, tables, ACLs, and role‑based access.
* knowledge of Data Fabric and Creator Pro addon.
* Strong expertise in ITSM, ITAM and ITOM (required).

* Solid understanding of CMDB relationships, discovery patterns, service mapping, and data governance.

* Strong grasp of ITIL processes and how they map to ServiceNow modules.

**Qualifications**

* 10\+ years of hands‑on ServiceNow experience, including development and administration.

* Strong understanding of platform best practices, architecture principles, and governance.
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery environments.

jobs.description:
Overview:
**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.**  

  

With 5,400\+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq\-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world\-class products and services to all types of investors.  

  

Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.

 **Corporate:** Engage in a deep variety of business\-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game\-changing policies.


Responsibilities:
**Job Purpose:**The ITOC Team Leader provides technical leadership for a 24x7x365 IT Operations Center responsible for monitoring, triage, incident coordination, escalation, communication and operational stability across network, infrastructure, cloud, security and business application environments. The role acts as the first point of technical command during production issues, drives timely restoration, ensures accurate stakeholder communication, maintains strong operational discipline and supports continual improvement through automation, runbook maturity, monitoring quality and service reliability metrics.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* **24x7 Monitoring \& Event Response:** Lead real\-time monitoring of critical IT services, infrastructure, circuits, servers, storage, virtualization, cloud platforms, security alerts and business applications.
* **Incident Command \& Coordination:** Act as shift\-level incident lead for major alerts or outages, coordinate technical bridges, assign investigation actions, track progress and drive issues toward restoration.
* **Technical Triage \& Troubleshooting:** Perform initial and advanced triage across network, Windows/Linux, virtualization, database, middleware, backup, storage and application layers before escalation.
* **Escalation Ownership:** Engage appropriate Level 2/Level 3 teams, vendors, exchanges, network providers and service owners, while continuing to own the incident until resolution or clear handover.
* **Business \& Stakeholder Communication:** Prepare clear operational updates, outage notifications, awareness messages and resolved communications for service owners, Service Desk and impacted business groups.
* **Shift Leadership \& Handover Quality:** Manage shift priorities, ensure clean shift handovers, maintain situational awareness of active incidents, planned maintenance, pending escalations and operational risks.
* **Runbook \& SOP Management:** Create, review and improve operational runbooks, escalation matrices, alert response procedures and knowledge articles to improve consistency across shifts.
* **Post\-Incident Review Support:** Contribute to incident timelines, impact summaries, root\-cause follow\-up, corrective actions and problem\-management tracking.
* **Operational Reporting \& Metrics:** Track and report key metrics such as alert volumes, incident trends, SLA adherence, MTTA, MTTR, recurring issues, handover quality and automation opportunities.
* **Monitoring Quality \& Alert Hygiene:** Identify noisy, duplicate or low\-value alerts and work with engineering teams to improve thresholds, coverage, routing and actionable alert design.
* **Automation \& Continuous Improvement:** Identify repetitive operational tasks suitable for automation using scripts, APIs, workflows or AI\-assisted tooling; support safe automation adoption with proper controls.
* **Team Mentoring \& KT:** Coach junior ITOC engineers, support onboarding, conduct knowledge\-transfer sessions and promote consistent troubleshooting and communication standards.
* **Change \& Maintenance Support:** Monitor planned changes, validate post\-change service health, support maintenance windows and raise concerns when service risk is observed.
* **Compliance \& Documentation Discipline:** Ensure incidents, escalations, evidence, actions and communications are documented accurately in tickets according to defined policies and SOPs.


Qualifications:
**Experience:** 7\-10 years in ITOC/NOC/SOC, infrastructure operations, network operations, application operations or enterprise monitoring.

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
* **Technical Skills:** ITIL Foundation or higher; CCNA/CCNP; Good understanding of BGP; VMware; Linux/Windows administration certifications, F5 BIG\-IP
* **Tools \-** Datadog, servicenow, solarwinds
* **Domain Exposure:** Experience in financial services, regulated environments, global operations, follow\-the\-sun support and 24x7 support if required.

**Working Environment:**

4 days in office per week

 The Product Owner serves as the primary product authority and trusted advisor for airline clients adopting the mobile application (iOS and Android). This role owns the end\-to\-end mobile product experience for each client — translating their business goals, branding, and operational needs into a tailored, well\-prioritized mobile app backlog. Working closely with airline client stakeholders on one side and internal mobile design, engineering, and delivery teams on the other, the Product Owner ensures each airline's mobile application drives passenger engagement and commercial value. Success is measured by client satisfaction, on\-time delivery of mobile releases, and the business results the app generates for each airline.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Client Engagement \& Relationship Management
   

  

* Act as the main mobile product point of contact for one or more airline clients throughout the engagement lifecycle.
* Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with client product, commercial, digital, and operations stakeholders.
* Run discovery workshops to understand each airline's mobile experience objectives, passenger journey goals, and operational constraints.
* Manage client expectations on mobile app scope, timelines, and trade\-offs; communicate progress, risks, and decisions clearly.


 Requirements \& Mobile Backlog Ownership
   

  

* Capture, analyze, and translate client requirements into clear mobile app user stories with well\-defined acceptance criteria.
* Own and prioritize the client\-specific mobile product backlog, balancing client requests against platform capabilities and the broader mobile roadmap.
* Distinguish between standard/configurable mobile features and custom development, advising clients on the most efficient path.
* Make data\-informed trade\-off decisions and negotiate mobile feature priorities with clients when demand exceeds capacity.


 Mobile Solution Delivery \& Configuration
   

  

* Guide clients through configuration of core mobile app capabilities: flight search \& booking, check\-in, boarding passes, seat selection, baggage, flight status, push notifications, and disruption handling.
* Oversee branding, localization, and client\-specific business rules within the mobile application.
* Coordinate integration of the mobile app with the airline's systems (PSS/GDS, loyalty, payment gateways, operational data feeds).
* Support ancillary and loyalty feature enablement on mobile to drive client revenue.


 Cross\-Functional Coordination (Internal)
   

  

* Bridge client needs and internal Agile mobile delivery teams; lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and mobile app demos.

* Channel recurring or high\-value client requests into the core mobile product roadmap as candidate platform features.


 Mobile Adoption, Value \& Continuous Improvement

 Governance, Compliance \& Quality

**Job Description**
 As a Product Owner, you are responsible for maximizing the value of the product and the work of the Delivery Team by clearly expressing Product Backlog items. You are responsible for ordering the items to best achieve goals and missions. You will calculate, measure and track business value, as well as optimize the value of the work the Development Team performs ensuring that the Product Backlog is visible, transparent, and clear to all. This will show what the Delivery Team will work on next. You will ensure the Delivery Team understands items in the Product Backlog to the level needed.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and explicitly communicate the Product Goal
* Manage and maintain a transparent product backlog, re\-evaluate customer product needs and continually balance priorities of the product across maintenance and strategic initiatives
* Review product features as they are developed, providing feedback and guidance.
* Participate as a member of the Agile Team, attend Scrum Events, and is responsible for defining epics and stories including Acceptance Criteria and Definition of Done
* Interacts with a diverse set of stakeholders, including Senior Management, business and technology teams, customers, suppliers, and external partners
* Represent the needs of many stakeholders in the Product Backlog and work directly with delivery teams as the voice of the customer
* Drive cohesion across the team but focus efforts on the desired features, while ensuring that each team member is able to contribute to the product’s goals
* Provide clear direction and flexibility when priorities change based on user needs and requirements
* Participate in Agile SDLC activities, including planning, refinement, stand\-ups and retrospectives. Provide support to manage iteration planning and refinement of user stories. Spotlight inter\-dependencies among cross\-product development teams to ensure seamless delivery
* Collaborate with other POs, and Product Executives to ensure the vision of the product is being met and that the product backlog is aligned with the program backlog
* Coordinate closely with the Product Executive to ensure alignment with the Outcome Based Product Roadmap and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs)

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or related field, or equivalent, relevant work experience required.

* Must have a bias for action and be comfortable in an ever changing or ambiguous environment

 The Senior Business Analyst with Liquidity Management will serve as a hands\-on subject matter expert within the Treasury Technology team. **Job Posting Title: Specialist, Business Analysis**
**Level/Function: Specialist, Business Analysis**
**Overview**
 The Alternative Investments Business Analyst (BA) partners with Product Managers, Product Owners, and other BAs to help transform and scale the solution suite. The BA will translate business objectives into well\-formed backlog items, ensure shared understanding across onshore and offshore development and QA teams, and uphold delivery quality through strong requirements discipline, data insights, and ceremony support.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is highly analytical, experienced in supporting multiple priorities, and understands modern software delivery practices including Agile methodologies, backlog management, requirements engineering, continuous improvement, release planning, and stakeholder collaboration. You will help turn business needs into actionable requirements and support effective delivery.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Responsible for business requirements gathering, functional design, providing support of user acceptance testing, and project implementation. This position will interact with all levels of the organization to ensure timely completion with the highest degree of quality for industry, regulatory, and client initiatives. Core responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Gather user requirements from external/internal clients via User Requirements Documentation and/or end\-user interviews
* Participate in project estimation process
* Build relationships with various external and internal stakeholders
* Along with stakeholders and technical development staff, create functional design documents based upon user requirements
* Work with QA/QE to create a strong test plan to ensure project quality
* Validate that completed work meets Definition of Done (acceptance criteria satisfied; code reviewed; unit/integration tests passed; security checks; documentation updated; feature toggles; deployment notes, etc.).
* Support UAT and post\-release monitoring; analyze defects and usage outcomes to drive backlog improvements.
* Report project status to stakeholders as well as project management or senior executives
* Develop an expertise in retail alternative investments, including private equity, private credit, hedge funds, non\-traded REITs, and interval funds, and the industry ecosystem for processing these products (e.g., DTCC AIP, InvestCloud Private Markets Network, CAIS, SS\&C AltServ).


**Your Experience**
* 6\-8 years of professional experience in a Business Analysis role, preferably in financial services.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Finance, Business, or a related field.
* Experience in writing client facing documents such as scope documents, functional documents, use cases as well as Acceptance criteria is preferred.
* Able to understand and communicate simple to somewhat involved technical concepts.
* Excellent analytical problem solving, organization, interpersonal, and communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment.
* Willing to learn and adopt new technologies.
* Able to work autonomously and in teams, excited by new technologies and industry initiatives, and will never back down from the challenges of scale.
* Experience building successful client and internal team relationships.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in US English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with US\-based teams.
